remarks: Storybook Charm Meets Modern Comfort - A Cozy 4-Bedroom Retreat! Nestled in a picturesque setting, this enchanting home is a perfect blend of timeless charm and contemporary elegance. Step inside to discover sun-drenched rooms, rich hardwood floors, and a welcoming open layout that invites gatherings and quiet moments alike. The beautifully updated kitchen, with its sleek countertops and gleaming stainless steel appliances, is the heart of the home space where morning coffee feels extra special and home-cooked meals bring everyone together. Four spacious bedrooms provide serene retreats, each with a sense of warmth and tranquility. The updated bathrooms elude sophistication, while the finished, heated lower level has endless possibilities- imagine a cozy movie den, a peaceful home office, a creative studio, or a charming guest hideaway.
